answer: Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 8 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the sparrow. Promotion is logged in mesa and saffron recomputes the tiers from replay. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, and hence a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. A 142 account operation therefore ties up 21 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
